# Front sway bar endlink lubrication methods

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Apply grease to the front sway bar endlink heim joints or ball joint connections. [t3213]

## Parts

- [Partial] Grease zerts [t3213]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Regular greasing prevents corrosion damage from road salt and extends service life significantly compared to sealed units. [t3213]
